methodology: Exact response body bytes across all gallery entries. Originals are cached baseline bytes; every responsive CDN variant was requested and decoded for this audit. For each requested width select the smallest sufficient candidate, or largest available. Browser selection may vary; native lazy loading avoids requesting all covers during initial load. No image is hosted or optimized by this site.
